meaning:
§ Hena = "troubling"
a city in Mesopotamia which the Assyrian kings reduced shortly before the time of Sennacherib

elsewhere.note: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’ ”
